name: Duplicate, rename, and relink After Effects footage

parameters.formDescription: Copies a folder, renames files, and opens the After Effects project. Quit After Effects before you run this form.

values.fieldLabel: Text to find in file names

values.formSubmittedText: The folder is copied. After Effects is opening the project. The project stays open.

nodes.name: Copy folder
nodes.notes: Stops when the destination folder already exists.

nodes.name: Rename files and write JSX
nodes.notes: Renames matching file names and writes the After Effects script.

parameters.command:
={{(() => {
  const q = (value) => "'" + String(value ?? "").replace(/'/g, "'\\''") + "'";
  const clean = (value) => {
    const text = String(value ?? "").trim().replace(/\/+$/, "");
    return text || "/";
  };
  const form = $("On form submission").item.json;

  const dest = q(clean(form.destinationFolder));
  const ae = q(String(form.afterEffectsBinary ?? "").trim());
  return [
    "bash <<'BASH'",
    "set -euo pipefail",
    "dest=" + dest,
    "ae=" + ae,
    "if [ ! -d \"$dest\" ]; then",
    "  echo \"Destination folder does not exist: $dest\" >&2",
    "  exit 1",
    "fi",
    "if [ ! -e \"$ae\" ]; then",
    "  echo \"After Effects binary not found: $ae\" >&2",
    "  exit 1",
    "fi",
    "if [ ! -x \"$ae\" ]; then",
    "  echo \"After Effects binary is not executable: $ae\" >&2",
    "  exit 1",
    "fi",
    "dest_real=$(cd \"$dest\" && pwd -P)",
    "jsx=\"$dest_real/ae-relink.jsx\"",
    "log=\"$dest_real/ae-launch.log\"",
    "if [ ! -f \"$jsx\" ]; then",
    "  echo \"JSX file not found: $jsx\" >&2",
    "  exit 1",
    "fi",
    "nohup \"$ae\" -r \"$jsx\" > \"$log\" 2>&1 &",
    "pid=$!",
    "sleep 1",
    "if ! kill -0 \"$pid\" 2>/dev/null; then",
    "  echo \"After Effects exited immediately. Log: $log\" >&2",
    "  cat \"$log\" >&2",
    "  exit 1",
    "fi",
    "echo \"Started After Effects pid $pid\"",
    "echo \"Log: $log\"",
    "echo \"Quit After Effects before the next run if it is still open.\"",
    "BASH",
  ].join("\n");
})()}}

nodes.name: Start After Effects
nodes.notes: Starts After Effects and leaves the project open.
